exact_evidence_needed_to_proceed.name: approved fresh sample fixture
must_include: review decision or gate packet path approving the sample
question records that are not the H1 Solo q1-q3 seed cases
evidence paths to real exam questions, official correction models, or reviewed target exercises
source locator for each question or target exercise
authority boundary with all mutation/product-use flags false

exact_evidence_needed_to_proceed.name: official correction-model operation decomposition
must_include: operation_id for each official correction-model step
operation text or official answer-model summary
route tags for calculus, non_calculus, function_construction, point_calculation, incidence, answer_form, scaling, misconception, and procedure

exact_evidence_needed_to_proceed.name: reviewed answer-form and misconception evidence
must_include: question word or prompt action mapped to expected answer-form MTU or reviewed equivalent
predictable misconception tag, misconception evidence reference, or explicit not_applicable rationale
scale-factor/unit evidence where the source or answer model uses scale labels
procedure expectation for every apply/analyze MTU used by the mapping

exact_evidence_needed_to_proceed.name: negative regression fixture
must_include: at least one deliberately failing fixture that reintroduces an original Solo q1-q3 defect class
no protected reference mutation and no target-exercise mutation

proposed_fixture_schema.review_packet: path to approving packet or gate decision

defect_class_hooks.mechanical_assertion: For every official correction-model operation, require either at least one live expected_required_mtu_id or explicit review_required/missing_mtu_expected evidence.
Fail when mapped_mtu_ids include expected_forbidden_mtu_ids for the operation.
Fail when operation expects non_calculus and mapped route tags or MTUs include calculus/derivative-only route.
Fail when operation expects point_calculation and mapped route includes function_construction.
Fail when incidence_or_pass_through_expected is true and no incidence/pass-through MTU or reviewed equivalent is present.
Fail when a question word has no expected answer-form MTU or reviewed equivalent.
Fail when scale_factor_expected is true and no scaling/unit MTU or reviewed equivalent is present.
Fail when a predictable misconception is expected and neither misconception refs nor equivalent evidence exists.
For mapped apply/analyze units, fail when the live registry unit has no non-empty procedure unless the sample marks a concrete review_required hook.

preferred_distribution: at least one berekenen or calculation answer-model case
at least one leg_uit/analyseer reasoning case with misconception risk
at least one source, scale, graph, incidence, or pass-through case
allowed_sources: real exam questions with official correction-model evidence
reviewed target exercises with explicit review provenance
